Game day: insert moved card before the card at the target slot

Deliberately broken, never to be merged: indexes the destination column
without clamping, so a move to the end of a column (or into an empty
column) raises IndexError and returns 500. The unit suite catches this
(test_move_position_past_end_appends); the image is built locally and
deployed to staging only, bypassing CI, to exercise the incident responder.
